purpose: Cross-examine the Sol blind-review findings against the repaired current artifacts. This report is evidence of a same-family cross-examination only; it makes no quorum, admission, certification, or promotion claim.

cross_examination.assessment: Agreed. The repair does not, and should not, convert specified work into executed work. The specification and delta continue to label executable modeling, checking, runtime tests, TUF/in-toto implementation, simulation, and full STPA as pending.

Agreed. The repaired records strengthen truthfulness: each FunctionContract block is marked a requirement profile, with null machine ID/version and UNRESOLVED_REQUIRED_BEFORE_EXECUTABLE_ADMISSION. This resolves any implication that prose is already a machine-resolvable contract, but it does not resolve the missing machine bindings.

The 20 patches now separate a single canonical_owner_binding from affected_artifact_schema_profile_refs and include an owner_anchor_change_map with source path, hash, heading, line, anchor, and candidate technical anchor. This addresses the prior schema/contract-as-owner ambiguity for the candidate design. Exhaustive semantic compatibility of all owner fields remains outside this check.

Agreed with Sol's original objection. The prior handoff_entry_region was ambiguous and should not have been accepted as harmless. It is removed. EH-18 now defines takeover_recoverable_region(D,e), requires the actual uncertainty interval to fit the time-dependent region, states that [0,10] applies only at completed takeover with D=0 and a functioning fallback, and calls an empty interval nonrecoverable. The threshold is explicitly PROPOSED_ARITHMETIC_NOT_VALIDATED and a proof obligation lists error sign, sampling phase, age, monitoring, delay, actuator dynamics, command order, uncertainty propagation, and discretization. The continuous-time/interval proof and simulation evidence remain open.

The checker now describes itself as diff identity only and, when run against the current five-file expected-diff manifest, emits DIFF_MATCH_ONLY with claimed_admission_status NOT_ADMITTED, admitted_diff_verified false, canonical_promotion_authorized false, and no diff-identity failures. This prevents a successful byte-diff check from being labeled admitted-diff satisfaction.

The generated SECTION-INVENTORY now says its coverage scope is contiguous section-boundary segmentation only, exposes section_boundary_coverage_complete separately, and sets semantic_reference_closure_complete false. The separate closure receipt remains INCONCLUSIVE with complete_semantic_reference_closure false. Thus the artifacts do not present segmentation coverage as semantic closure. Semantic reference, SchemaID, FunctionContract, and proof-obligation closure remain open.

The new per-patch owner/anchor change maps and explicit projection policy materially improve the five-file ownership presentation. It remains only a candidate presentation because the records themselves state that cross-file projection links and machine references require builder/closure verification.
Agreed. The repaired candidate remains noncanonical and lacks executed assurance evidence, semantic closure, and required independent-family review.

Machine FunctionContract IDs and versions are explicitly unresolved before executable admission.
